query: What signals suggest an agent's tickets will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Symptom/topic of the incident (email, vpn, database) is knowable at intake and plausibly correlates with how long resolution takes. Lies outside the focus.

per_column.name: incident_symptom_type
per_column.rationale: Type of symptom (outage_down, access_denied, slow_performance) is available up front and carries signal about difficulty/duration. Not a restatement of resolution_time.

per_column.name: affected_scope
per_column.rationale: Blast radius (individual vs organization_wide) is known early and plausibly predictive of effort and hence duration.

per_column.name: service_outage_flag
per_column.rationale: Whether it is a service outage is derivable at intake and correlates with urgency/complexity, a legitimate predictor of resolution time.

per_column.name: remote_access_flag
per_column.rationale: Remote-access nature of the ticket is known at open time and can affect resolution difficulty; outside the focus.

per_column.name: assigned_agent
per_column.rationale: Agent identity is the core dimension of the query ('an agent's tickets'); different agents plausibly differ in speed. Known at assignment, before resolution completes.

per_column.name: cross_agent_resolution_flag
per_column.rationale: Whether the ticket was resolved across multiple agents (reassignments/handoffs) is only fully known once the resolution process has occurred; it is part of the resolution history and effectively co-determined with a long resolution time. Post-outcome leakage.

per_column.name: ticket_open_status
per_column.rationale: Whether the ticket is still open is a function of the resolution/closure event itself; unresolved tickets have no completed resolution_time. It restates/leaks the outcome rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: opened_hour_of_day
per_column.rationale: Time-of-day of opening is fully known at intake and plausibly predictive (off-hours may wait for staffing). Outside the focus.

per_column.name: opened_day_of_week
per_column.rationale: Weekday vs weekend at open time is known up front and can affect how quickly a ticket is handled; legitimate predictor.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are genuine, intake-time features (incident type/symptom/scope, outage and remote flags, agent identity, and opening time features) that lie outside resolution_time and plausibly carry predictive signal, directly supporting the 'which agent/what conditions predict slower resolution' query. Two columns (cross_agent_resolution_flag and ticket_open_status) leak or restate the outcome, since they are determined by the resolution/closure process itself. As a set they provide substantial legitimate predictive leverage beyond the original schema, but the presence of leakage columns and some redundancy caps the utility.
